# Search simple_note notes for dinner/shares
from math import ceil

sn_access_token = access_token  # from prior simple_note login

def fetch_notes(query, page_limit=20):
    all_items=[]
    page_index=0
    while True:
        resp=apis.simple_note.search_notes(access_token=sn_access_token, query=query, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, sort_by='-updated_at')
        items=resp if isinstance(resp, list) else resp.get('items', [])
        # response may be list directly based on API
        if not items:
            break
        all_items.extend(items)
        page_index += 1
    return all_items

for q in ['Friends Dinner','friends dinner','dinner','Dinner','share']:
    items=fetch_notes(q)
    print(q, 'count', len(items))
    if items:

            print('  ', it['note_id'], it['title'], it.get('updated_at'))

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
now=datetime.now(); yesterday=now.date()-timedelta(days=1); today=now.date()
print('today',today,'yesterday',yesterday)

# 1) Parse shares from note 3084 (spice symphony kitchen)
note=apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=3084, access_token=access_token)
print('note title',note['title'])
content=note['content']
print('content',content)

shares={}
for line in content.splitlines():
    line=line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- ' ) and '=>' in line:
        left,right=line[2:].split('=>')
        person=left.strip()
        amt_str=right.strip().lstrip('$')
        shares[person]=float(amt_str)
print('shares',shares)

# 2) Fetch venmo received transactions with description 'Friends Dinner' within yesterday
venmo_paid_tx=[]
page_index=0
while True:
    resp=apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=venmo_access, query='Friends Dinner',
                                      min_created_at=str(yesterday), max_created_at=str(today),
                                      direction='received',
                                      page_index=page_index, page_limit=20, sort_by='-created_at')
    if not resp:
        break
